title: Deterministic quick checks and native watcher qualification
objective: Retain watcher correctness coverage in quick while making real OS notification delivery an explicit required native gate.
context_summary: The owner authorized the split after reproducible FSEvents delivery waits in aggregate quick runs. Keep production behavior and hang bounds unchanged. Main marks tests taking 100 ms or more slow; apply that policy to injected journeys as well. Native qualification failures remain open; they do not block independent harness delivery. See the contract for mandatory release and watcher-change coverage.

tasks.description: Make core watcher invariants deterministic using fixture-owned injected notifications and cursor observations.
extra_context: Implementation authorized by the owner. High-tier model minimum applies. No subagents or external inputs are required. Routine engineering choices are delegated within the contract.

context_links.label: Watcher verification contract

acceptance_criteria: Cheap quick watcher checks and slower ordinary journeys use the production lane over scratch files without native event delivery.
